decisions.reason: As an authentication and identity delegation service close to the firm's GeoIT integration work, it fits existing technical knowledge and can be improved through the firm's own R&D, while its move from a mention to a dedicated page suggests growing commitment.

The open GIS application development framework is closely related to the firm's established software-component business and benefits from strong absorptive capacity, though the weaker 2024 website positioning than some other products raises a moderate risk of rationalization.

This identity and access service for GIS applications is tightly connected to the firm's core integration and enterprise-system expertise, and its dedicated 2024 page indicates that management sees enough market and learning potential to continue.

The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's consulting and training capabilities, so it is easy to absorb and refine, but as a newly launched 2024 service it still faces some uncertainty over repeatable demand.
